text:
samir: spinning up new eu-north1 kubeadm cluster for inference-gpu. planning mixed spot+on-demand nodepools. bootstrapping now — want quick validation + handoff checklist.

priya: heads up — eu-north1 has low A100 quota atm, I filed quota request (INC-4892). won’t block control-plane, but GPU node provisioning may be delayed. also need to confirm VPC MTU 9001 for RDMA physiology.

alex: this is kubeadm on our colo racks (not EKS). plan: calico with vxlan disabled, IPIP off, mtu 8900. containerd + nvidia-container-runtime. daemonset for driver install + device-plugin. kubelet args: --node-labels=gpu=true --eviction-hard=memory.available<200Mi,nodefs.available<10%

renee: small ops notes: taint spot-pool gpu=spot:NoSchedule; add tolerations to inference-daemonset. set kube-reserved and system-reserved on GPU nodes. ensure node-exporter collects nvidia_smi metrics.

deploy-bot: cluster-create: control-plane x3 ready. join-token expires in 23h. workspace: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/k8s-bootstrap (runbook auto-attached).

samir: quick validation commands to run after node joins: `kubectl get nodes -o wide`; `kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l app=nvidia -o wide`; `kubectl describe ds nvidia-driver -n kube-system`; `kubectl logs -n kube-system -l app=nvidia-device-plugin`

priya: also run network perf: `iperf3 -s` in a pod, and from another pod `iperf3 -c <ip> -P 4` to validate pod-to-pod 10Gb. verify NAT gateway throughput and disable source/dest check on nat instances.

alex: cost fallback: spot eviction ~7% in these AZs. set cluster-autoscaler with mixed instances, and an on-demand reserve pool (min 2) so critical routes keep capacity. labels: `node.kubernetes.io/lifecycle=spot` for spot nodes.

samir: handoff checklist for oncall (short):
1) grafana dashboard: apiserver/etcd/ kube-scheduler healthy
2) node allocatable alerts and OOM guard
3) GPU temp & power draw alerts (nvidia-smi exporter)
4) CNI flap alert and MTU mismatch alarms
5) quota ticket INC-4892 + expected ETA in runbook
6) playbook: drain spot nodes -> cordon -> scale up on-demand pool -> evict pods with disruption budget

renee: kubeadm config snippet I used (paste):
```
apiVersion: kubeadm.k8s.io/v1beta3
kind: ClusterConfiguration
networking:
  dnsDomain: cluster.local
  serviceSubnet: 10.96.0.0/12
  podSubnet: 10.244.0.0/16
controllerManager: {}
```
CRI: containerd (runc) + nvidia-container-runtime. Make sure `DevicePlugins` feature-gate on if needed.

samir: :thumbsup: I'll draft the full runbook (validation steps, commands, alerts, escalation contacts) and tag @oncall. target handoff in ~3h if no regression.

priya: one more — add a short smoke test: `./bench/latency_check.sh --model llama2 --seq 512` to validate sequence perf and warmup KV cache. results go to perf-dashboard.
